topic: AC systems - schematic of external power supply, auxiliary power units
syllabus_extract: AC systems - schematic of external power supply, auxiliary power units. Practical on 6-Pin Receptacle system. Introduction to Power Quality analysis (PQA)
specific_objectives: 13.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain the A/C power systems.

practical: Practical on 6-Pin Receptacle system. Safety precautions: Verify power off, wear PPE. Instructor supervision: Monitor connections and voltage checks.
intro_questions: What are the primary sources of AC power for an aircraft?
Define the function of an Auxiliary Power Unit (APU).
Identify the pin configuration of the standard 6-Pin Receptacle system.

development.content:

Frequency stability checks

summary_questions: Explain the role of the interlock mechanism in preventing simultaneous power sources.
Describe two key parameters monitored during Power Quality Analysis (PQA).
List the safety steps required before connecting an external power supply.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the need for static converting equipment (rectifiers, inverters) as covered in the next lesson plan (LP 08), focusing on why AC systems require conversion in specific aircraft zones.

pft_rows.syllabus: Need and types of Static converting equipment - rectifiers, transformers, transformer rectifier units, rotary inverters, static inverters and automatic change over system. Practical on inverter, transformer & rectifier.
